description: Estimate what an AI, verify, scrape or Flow run would cost, for a number of rows, for a list (for a Flow too, where Flows on lists are on), or (for a Flow) for the rows on a connected sheet. A Flow estimate also returns needed_to_start_cents, the balance a run needs to start; with spreadsheet_id it also returns output_columns and reused_columns: the columns the Flow would write (token to letter), and which of them already exist on the sheet. Uses the same calculation as the Sorzio add-on. For your workspace the estimate is what Sorzio will charge: $0.00 on an internal workspace, for AI on your own key on Pro or Scale, and for Verify on your own No2Bounce key on Scale (charge_note says why). needed_to_start_cents is the balance the run holds while it runs, which can be more than the estimate; the unused part is returned when the run ends. A scrape estimate is the most the run can cost; usual_cost_cents is what most runs are charged. Signed out, estimates are list prices. Free.

flow_id.description: Required for kind flow. The Flow's flow_id from list_flows.

header_row.description: Kind flow only. Row number of the header. Defaults to 1.

input_columns.description: Kind flow only. Maps a Flow input to a sheet header when the names differ, for example {"email": "Work email"}.

list_id.description: Use this list's row count instead of rows (for kind flow too, where Flows on lists are on). Rows a Flow removed are not counted.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to openai/gpt-4o-mini for kind ai when omitted.

only_rows_where.description: When estimating a list run, count only the rows that match this filter.

rows.description: Row count. Up to 25,000 for ai, verify and scrape, and up to 50,000 for a Flow.

spreadsheet_id.description: Kind flow only, instead of rows: the sheet id or full docs.google.com URL. The rows are counted on the Flow's input columns.

tab.description: Kind flow only. Tab name. Defaults to the first tab.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate the cost of a run
